g.text: The Z₃ × Z₃ voltage graph behind the 126 vertices

text.tspan: Node u stands for the fibre {(,):∈}. An arrow → with label means (,)∼(,+); grey edges have voltage 0.
Triangles → carry (−)(0,2); edges → carry with =(2,0),(1,1),(1,0). The right half repeats the voltages of the left half.
